_doc: Release specific values of the dialog text tables (tools/translate/texttables.py).  option_vram: aTextDataTableFFFE, the VRAM word address stored in strcDialogDisplay.glyphVramAddr for the selected answer (0-4) of an <OPT n> selection menu.  dialog_banks: the first dialog id of every ROM bank that holds dialogs (translate/<region>/dialogs.txt is cut at these ids, every bank is padded to $8000).
